city_not_found: Could not determine your current city.
compass_error: Could not read the compass sensor.
license_aladhan_desc: Prayer times, the Hijri calendar and calculation methods are obtained from this service. It requires no API key or membership.
license_city_db_desc: The names, coordinates and country-language relations of 245 countries and 141,135 cities are taken from this data set.
license_country_lang_desc: Information about which languages each country officially uses is taken from this data set.
license_geonames_desc: The canonical names and coordinates of large cities are taken from this data set. Since the main data set focuses on the district and village level, some major cities (e.g. Kahramanmaraş, Konya) were not included in it.
license_geonames_notice: This application uses the GeoNames cities15000 data set (© GeoNames, CC BY 4.0). GeoNames data has been merged with the application's own city database: the small settlement records of the source have been preserved, the canonical names and coordinates of major cities have been added, and duplicate records carrying the same coordinates have been merged. These changes were made with the tool/sehir_birlestir.dart and tool/mukerrer_birlestir.dart tools in this repository.
license_iso639_desc: The names of 152 languages in their own language and the ISO 639 code mapping are taken from this data set.
license_odbl_notice: This application contains data taken from data sets licensed under the Open Database Commons Open Database License (ODbL-1.0). Because ODbL-1.0 is a copyleft licence, applications that use and distribute this data must clearly state the source of the data. The licence terms of the source data sets are applied unchanged.
license_quran_desc: Verse texts and their translations are obtained from this service. Each translation has its own source.
loc_error: Location not found. Continuing with the previous city.
loc_perm_denied: Location permission denied. Continuing with the saved city.
loc_service_off: Location services are disabled. Continuing with the saved city.
method_auto_desc: The official method for your country is selected automatically.
method_help: The calculation method changes the times. If unsure, pick the method used by the mosque you attend, or leave it automatic.
no_city_data: No city data available for this country.
no_compass: No compass sensor found on your device.
no_internet_city: No internet connection! Could not fetch data for {}.
notif_channel_bg_desc: Alerts you when a prayer time arrives while the app is closed
notif_channel_desc: Alerts you when a prayer time arrives or approaches
notif_channel_early_desc: Reminds you to prepare before the prayer time
notif_early_body: {vakit} is in {dakika} minutes. Time to get ready!
qibla_not_found: Unable to calculate the Qibla because the location could not be determined.
